prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: repeating watercolor wood texture for a reading-table website.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Keep its warm honey-oak palette, softly painted horizontal wooden planks, organic understated wood grain, tactile watercolor-paper texture, and peaceful handmade feeling.
Change only the features that prevent clean repetition: remove ALL leaf/branch shadows, corner decorations, corner glows, sunbeams, diagonal illumination, unique highlighted areas, dark vignettes, edge flourishes, borders, and abrupt light-to-dark patches. Replace those areas with the same ordinary evenly lit watercolor wood as the rest of the surface. Do not introduce new decoration.
Composition: a flat directly overhead full-bleed rectangular wood surface, landscape 1536x1024, no visible outer tabletop edge or perspective. Four broad horizontal boards with subtle straight fine board joins. Keep gently varied low-contrast grain distributed evenly across the image, no conspicuous recurring large knots.
This is a tileable material texture, not a framed illustration. Uniform soft ambient illumination across the entire tile, consistent warmth and brightness at all four edges. Top and bottom edges MUST meet cleanly when the image repeats downward: place the repeat boundary at a natural thin horizontal plank joint, with the same subtle joint treatment as the interior joins, no duplicated heavy seam and no unfinished flourish. Left/right grain should also continue naturally across boundaries. Maintain the original watercolor theme and styling; do not switch to photography, flat vector, or generic noise.
No books, props, leaves, shadows from objects, text, labels, watermark, empty margins, transparency, corners, frame, or border. Output one full-bleed opaque texture tile only.
